parts.title: Passage 1
parts.article_title: What to do if your clothes have been lost or damaged by a dry cleaner

paragraphs.text: Dry cleaners are legally required to take reasonable care of anything left with them. You can claim compensation if your belongings are damaged or lost while in their care.
paragraphs.translation:
干洗店在法律上有义务合理保管顾客留下的任何物品。
如果您的物品在干洗店保管期间损坏或丢失，您可以要求赔偿。

paragraphs.text: Even if the dry cleaning company has a sign saying they aren't responsible for items left with them, this isn't necessarily true. They can't opt out of this responsibility just by putting up a sign.
paragraphs.translation:
即使干洗公司悬挂告示称其对顾客留下的物品不负责任，这也未必属实。
他们不能仅仅通过张贴告示来规避此项责任。

paragraphs.text: As soon as you realise there's a problem, contact them and explain the situation. They might offer you compensation straight away. If they don't, you should ask them to either cover the cost of repairing the item or to pay for a replacement (if it can't be repaired).
paragraphs.translation:
一旦你意识到有问题，就立即联系他们并说明情况。
他们可能会立即提供赔偿。
如果他们不这样做，你应该要求他们要么支付物品的维修费用，要么赔偿一件替代品（如果无法修复的话）。

paragraphs.text: If they have to pay the cost of replacing a damaged or lost item, the maximum they're obliged to offer you is the value of the item when it was left with them, not what it would cost to replace as new. You'll probably be asked to provide evidence of how much it originally cost - for example, a receipt. The dry cleaner can then offer you a reduced amount depending on the condition of the item - you'll have to negotiate the cost with them.
paragraphs.translation:
如果他们必须支付损坏或丢失物品的更换费用，他们有义务给予您的最高金额是该物品交给他们时的价值，而不是更换成新物品所需的价格。
您很可能会被要求提供物品原始成本的证据，例如收据。
随后，干洗店可以根据物品的状况向您提供较低金额的赔偿，您需要与他们协商这笔费用。

paragraphs.text: If the dry cleaner is part of a national chain, you could get in touch with the customer services department of their head office and make the complaint to them directly.
paragraphs.translation: 如果该干洗店属于全国连锁店，你可以联系其总公司的客服部门，并直接向他们投诉。

paragraphs.text: If the dry cleaner refuses to compensate you or they offer you too little, try the following steps:
paragraphs.translation: 如果干洗店拒绝赔偿你，或者他们给的赔偿太少，请尝试以下步骤：

paragraphs.text: · If the dry cleaner is a member of a trade association such as the UK Fashion and Textile Association, you can pass your complaint to them and they may be able to help you.
paragraphs.translation: · 如果干洗店是某个行业协会（如英国时装与纺织协会）的成员，你可以将投诉转交给他们，他们可能会帮助你。

paragraphs.text: · You could get an independent organisation to look at your issue and produce a report, but this could be expensive (often around ￡100).
paragraphs.translation: · 你可以请一个独立的机构来审查你的问题并出具报告，但这可能很昂贵（通常约为100英镑）。

paragraphs.text: If you've tried the options above and are still unhappy with the outcome, you could take your case to court. There's a time limit for going to court - from when you took the item to the dry cleaner, you have up to six years.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你已经尝试了上述选择，但仍然对结果不满意，你可以将案件诉诸法庭。
提起诉讼有时间限制——从你把物品交给干洗店算起，你有最多六年的时间。

paragraphs.text: Groups for readers and writers
paragraphs.translation: 读者与写作小组

paragraphs.text: A Teen vision
paragraphs.translation: 青少年视野

paragraphs.text: This is a reading group for teens aged 12-16 which meets on the last Thursday of the month. We are a friendly group, with everybody keen to talk about what we've enjoyed reading recently and make suggestions on what we should read next.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一个面向12至16岁青少年的阅读小组，每月最后一个星期四聚会。
我们是一个友好的团体，每个人都热衷于谈论自己最近喜欢的读物，并就下一步应该读什么提出建议。

paragraphs.text: We are massive fans of action, fantasy and adventure but we try to include a mix of genres in our choices.
paragraphs.translation: 我们是动作、奇幻和冒险类作品的忠实爱好者，但我们会尽量在选择中涵盖多种类型的题材。

paragraphs.text: B Creative writing workshops
paragraphs.translation: B 创意写作工作坊

paragraphs.text: Would you like to share your writing with others and hear their constructive suggestions for how to improve it? Have you got a book inside you but need the inspiration to get started? Build your confidence to begin formulating ideas for story lines and characters at our regular workshops.
paragraphs.translation:
你是否愿意与他人分享你的作品，并听取他们关于如何改进的建设性建议？
你是否心中有一本书，却需要灵感来开始动笔？
在我们定期的研讨会上建立自信，开始构思故事情节和人物角色。

paragraphs.text: Open to all -beginners and established writers.
paragraphs.translation: 面向所有人开放——无论是初学者还是资深作家。

paragraphs.text: C Books for now
paragraphs.translation: C 当下读物

paragraphs.text: We meet on the second and fourth Mondays of each month in members' homes. The group is open to men and women who enjoy discussing the themes and issues found in science fiction novels. Our books are usually those written from the 1960s onwards and include feminist science fiction, cyberpunk and scientific romance.
paragraphs.translation:
我们每月在第二和第四个星期一于成员家中会面。
该小组对乐于讨论科幻小说中主题与议题的男性和女性开放。
我们通常阅读20世纪60年代以后撰写的作品，包括女性主义科幻、赛博朋克和科学浪漫小说。

paragraphs.text: D Readers' book group
paragraphs.translation: D 读者读书小组

paragraphs.text: This is an open group for parents at the library, and toddlers are welcome to come along and play in the children's library while the meeting is taking place. The group reads mainly fiction of different genres. Books are supplied by the library. Anyone is welcome - have a look at our website to see what the book is for the next meeting.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一个面向图书馆家长的开放小组，开会期间欢迎幼儿一同前来，在儿童图书馆玩耍。
该小组主要阅读不同类型的小说。
书籍由图书馆提供。
欢迎任何人加入——请查看我们的网站，了解下次会议要读的书。

paragraphs.text: E The book club
paragraphs.translation: E 读书俱乐部

paragraphs.text: Every month members of this group read a fabulous business book which is then discussed when we meet. At our meetings you'll have the chance to network with other members - all like-minded businesswomen - in a relaxed environment. There will be lots of ideas to discuss, as well as refreshments and lots of fun!
paragraphs.translation:
这个小组的成员每个月都会阅读一本精彩的商业书籍，然后在聚会上进行讨论。
在我们的聚会上，你将有机会在轻松的环境中与其他成员——全是志同道合的女商人——建立联系。
届时会有许多想法可供讨论，还有茶点供应和许多乐趣！

paragraphs.text: F Poetry writing group
paragraphs.translation: F 诗歌写作小组

paragraphs.text: A writing group for young poets aged between 12 and 18 at the library. You will explore how to power up your imagination, and your poems will be displayed in the library and online. The group meets fortnightly on Saturdays from 12 p.m. to 2 p.m. The group is currently full but anyone interested is welcome to join the membership waiting list.
paragraphs.translation:
这是一个在图书馆为12至18岁年轻诗人设立的写作小组。
你将探索如何激发想象力，你的诗歌将在图书馆和线上展示。
该小组每两周在周六中午12点至下午2点聚会。
该小组目前名额已满，但欢迎任何有兴趣的人加入会员等候名单。

questions.location_analysis: 原文指出干洗店即使贴出免责声明，也不能逃避责任。

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 该选项与原文信息矛盾，原文可能指出公司并非必须退原价。

questions.location_analysis: 原文提到可向行业协会投诉并获得帮助。
questions.paraphrasing: get support from a dry cleaners' trade association -> pass your complaint to them

options.label: TRUE
FALSE

questions.paraphrasing: request a free report -> get an independent organisation... produce a report, but this could be expensive

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 该选项与原文信息矛盾，原文明确否认了在补偿太少时可以请求免费报告。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文中已经直接提到了相关内容（即补偿太少时无法请求免费报告），因此并非未给出。

questions.prompt: Most people who take a case about a dry-cleaning company to court are satisfied with the outcome.

options.label: TRUE

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及大多数人对干洗公司诉讼结果是否满意，该信息在文中没有依据。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提供关于人们对干洗公司诉讼结果满意度的信息，无法断定其不属实。

options.label: TRUE

questions.analysis: 题干询问九个月前丢失物品是否仍可起诉，原文最后一句指出“from when you took the item to the dry cleaner, you have up to six years”可提起诉讼，九个月远在六年期限内，因此仍可起诉。该陈述与原文一致，答案为 TRUE。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you've tried the options above and are still unhappy with the outcome, you could take your case to court.

sentence_translations.sentence: There's a time limit for going to court - from when you took the item to the dry cleaner, you have up to six years.

paragraphs.text: If some simple precautions are taken, lifting equipment that is essential for construction and engineering projects can be used safely. Forklift trucks, lifting trolleys, mobile and fixed cranes and all their parts are classed as lifting equipment.
paragraphs.translation:
如果采取一些简单的预防措施，对于建筑和工程项目至关重要的起重设备就能安全使用。
叉车、起重手推车、移动式和固定式起重机及其所有部件都被归类为起重设备。

paragraphs.text: All equipment used for lifting or moving heavy loads should be properly constructed. For example, equipment bearing a CE mark has been constructed to international standards. In addition, equipment that meets these standards will have documented instructions for tests that should be adhered to prior to using the equipment. Certain types of machinery, such as cranes, must be inspected by a qualified engineer on a six-monthly basis.
paragraphs.translation:
所有用于起吊或搬运重物的设备都应妥善制造。
例如，带有CE标志的设备是按照国际标准制造的。
此外，符合这些标准的设备将附带书面测试说明，这些说明应在使用设备前严格遵守。
某些类型的机械，例如起重机，必须由合格的工程师每六个月进行一次检查。

paragraphs.text: For operations that use cranes, a formal lift plan must be prepared. Lift plans are a type of risk assessment, where by the possible dangers of the operation are carefully calculated, and control measures are identified and put in place. Before any lift proceeds, the plan should be talked over with the lifting crew during what is often referred to as a "Tool Box Talk" (TBT) This is an important opportunity for them to ask questions about their role in the operation.
paragraphs.translation:
对于使用起重机进行操作，必须制定正式的起重计划。
起重计划是一种风险评估，通过该评估可以仔细计算操作中可能出现的危险，并确定并实施控制措施。
在任何起重操作开始前，应在常被称为“工具箱谈话”(TBT)的会议中与起重团队讨论该计划，这是他们提问关于自身在操作中角色的重要机会。

paragraphs.text: When heavy loads being moved around, there are some practical things that should be done to prevent accidents.
paragraphs.translation: 当重型货物被移动时，应当采取一些切实可行的措施来防止事故发生。

paragraphs.text: Firstly, if a load needs to be moved where workers or members of the public are present, the area must have barriers or other means to ensure no one is allowed to walk under the load while it is moving. Secondly, someone called a banksman should always be used when moving heavy loads by crane. As a crane driver often cannot see the load, especially during touch-down, this person tells him or her which way to move it.
paragraphs.translation:
首先，如果一个负载需要在有工人或公众的场所移动，该区域必须设有围栏或其他措施，以确保在负载移动时没有人被允许从其下方穿行。
其次，在通过起重机移动重物时，必须始终安排一名被称为“指挥员”的人员。
由于起重机驾驶员通常无法看到负载，尤其是在着地时，该人员会指示驾驶员如何移动负载。

paragraphs.text: It is very unusual for machinery such as cranes to fail. However, it is all too easy to ignore the importance of the secondary equipment. This refers to those items that are attached between the mechanical lifting machine and the load that is being lifted. Chains, slings, shackles and rigging are all examples of secondary lifting equipment, and it is perhaps surprising to note that most injuries occur due to faults or weaknesses in these items. It is essential that a six-monthly visual inspection is carried out to ensure there are no signs of wear or damage to the slings and shackles.
paragraphs.translation:
像起重机这样的机械设备发生故障是非常罕见的。
然而，人们很容易忽视辅助设备的重要性。
这指的是连接在机械起重设备和被提升重物之间的部件。
链条、吊索、卸扣和索具都是辅助起重设备的例子，而令人惊讶的是，大多数伤害都是由这些部件的缺陷或弱点造成的。
必须每六个月进行一次目视检查，以确保吊索和卸扣没有磨损或损坏的迹象。

paragraphs.text: Dealing with customer complaints
paragraphs.translation: 处理客户投诉

paragraphs.text: When a customer complains, it is usually for a good reason. Here are some strategies that will help you handle a customer complaint in a smooth and professional manner.
paragraphs.translation:
当客户提出投诉时，通常是有充分理由的。
以下是一些策略，可帮助您以顺畅且专业的方式处理客户投诉。

paragraphs.text: When a customer presents you with a complaint, keep in mind that the issue is not personal. Aiming to win the confrontation accomplishes nothing. He or she has usually made a purchase that did not meet their expectations - a product, service, or maybe a combination of the two. A worker who remains in control of their emotions deals from a position of strength.
paragraphs.translation:
当顾客向你提出投诉时，请记住问题并非针对个人。
试图赢得对抗毫无意义。
他或她通常购买了一件未达到期望的商品——可能是产品、服务，或两者的结合。
能够控制自身情绪的员工具备优势地位来处理问题。

paragraphs.text: Let the customer say what they need to. Respond with phrases such as,‘Hmm’,'I see’, and 'Tell me more'. Then be quiet. As the customer expresses their annoyance yet sees you are not reacting, he or she will begin to relax. The customer needs to do this before being able to hear your solution.
paragraphs.translation:
让顾客说出他们想说的话。
用诸如‘嗯’、‘我明白了’和‘再多说一些’这样的短语回应。
然后保持安静。
当顾客表达他们的不满，却看到你没有反应时，他或她就会开始放松。
顾客需要先做到这一点，才能听得进你的解决方案。

paragraphs.text: When the customer has calmed down and feels you have heard his or her side, start asking questions. Be careful not to give scripted replies but use this as an opportunity to start a genuine conversation, building relationship of trust with your customer. To help you under stand the situation, get as many details as possible.
paragraphs.translation:
当顾客冷静下来，并且感到你已听取了他的观点时，开始提问。
注意不要给出照本宣科的回复，而是以此为契机开启一场真诚的对话，与顾客建立信任关系。
为了帮助你理解情况，尽可能获取更多细节。

paragraphs.text: Take charge of the situation and let the customer know what you are going to do to solve the problem. One thing to keep in mind is that you should know what you can and cannot do within the policy of the business you work for. The cost could be minimal maybe a simple upgrade on the customer’s next purchase or a small gift certificate. A simple gesture like this could result in a word-of-mouth recommendation to others, while making a promise you cannot commit to will only set you back.
paragraphs.translation:
掌控局面，并让客户知道你打算如何解决这个问题。
需要牢记的一点是，你应该清楚在所在公司的政策范围内，哪些是你可以做的，哪些是不能做的。
成本可能很低，也许只是客户下次购买时的一次简单升级，或是一张小额的礼品券。
像这样简单的举动可能会带来他人的口碑推荐，而做出你无法兑现的承诺只会让你倒退。

questions.prompt: ⚪ Remember it is not a direct attack on you. — ⚪ Do not try to _____ the argument.
questions.analysis: 题干要求填写不要试图去做的行为，原文第八段提到“Aiming to win the confrontation accomplishes nothing”，其中“win the confrontation”对应题干中的“win the argument”。“confrontation”与“argument”为同义替换，因此“win”是唯一符合语境和字数限制（ONE WORD ONLY）的动词答案。
questions.reason: 题干要求不要尝试的行为，原文为win。
questions.location_analysis: 不要试图赢得对抗。
questions.paraphrasing: do not try to -> aiming to … accomplishes nothing; argument -> confrontation
evidence: Aiming to win the confrontation accomplishes nothing.

questions.prompt: ⚪ usually had _____ that were not fulfilled.

questions.reason: 题干要求客户未满足的内容，原文为expectations。
questions.location_analysis: 客户购买的产品或服务未达到期望。
questions.paraphrasing: had -> made a purchase that did not meet; not fulfilled -> did not meet their expectations
evidence: He or she has usually made a purchase that did not meet their expectations - a product, service, or maybe a combination of the two.

questions.reason: 题干要求冷静前无法识别的内容，原文为solution。
questions.location_analysis: 客户在冷静前无法听见解决方案。

questions.location_analysis: 了解公司对投诉的政策。
questions.paraphrasing: company's -> the business you work for; on complaints -> on complaints (隐含)
evidence: One thing to keep in mind is that you should know what you can and cannot do within the policy of the business you work for.

questions.prompt: ⚪may well make a verbal _____ in future.
questions.analysis: 题干要求填写客户未来可能做出的口头行为，原文最后一句指出“A simple gesture like this could result in a word-of-mouth recommendation to others”，其中“word-of-mouth recommendation”对应题干中的“verbal recommendation in future”。“recommendation”为原文核心名词，符合“ONE WORD ONLY”的要求，准确体现积极服务可能带来的口碑效应。

sentence_translations.sentence: If some simple precautions are taken, lifting equipment that is essential for construction and engineering projects can be used safely.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果采取一些简单的预防措施，对于建筑和工程项目至关重要的起重设备就能安全使用。

sentence_translations.sentence: Forklift trucks, lifting trolleys, mobile and fixed cranes and all their parts are classed as lifting equipment.
sentence_translations.translation: 叉车、起重手推车、移动式和固定式起重机及其所有部件都被归类为起重设备。

sentence_translations.sentence: All equipment used for lifting or moving heavy loads should be properly constructed.
sentence_translations.translation: 所有用于起吊或搬运重物的设备都应妥善制造。

sentence_translations.sentence: For example, equipment bearing a CE mark has been constructed to international standards.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，带有CE标志的设备是按照国际标准制造的。

sentence_translations.sentence: In addition, equipment that meets these standards will have documented instructions for tests that should be adhered to prior to using the equipment.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，符合这些标准的设备将附带书面测试说明，这些说明应在使用设备前严格遵守。

sentence_translations.sentence: Certain types of machinery, such as cranes, must be inspected by a qualified engineer on a six-monthly basis.
sentence_translations.translation: 某些类型的机械，例如起重机，必须由合格的工程师每六个月进行一次检查。

sentence_translations.sentence: For operations that use cranes, a formal lift plan must be prepared.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于使用起重机进行操作，必须制定正式的起重计划。

sentence_translations.sentence: Lift plans are a type of risk assessment, where by the possible dangers of the operation are carefully calculated, and control measures are identified and put in place.
sentence_translations.translation: 起重计划是一种风险评估，通过该评估可以仔细计算操作中可能出现的危险，并确定并实施控制措施。

sentence_translations.sentence: Before any lift proceeds, the plan should be talked over with the lifting crew during what is often referred to as a "Tool Box Talk" (TBT) This is an important opportunity for them to ask questions about their role in the operation.
sentence_translations.translation: 在任何起重操作开始前，应在常被称为“工具箱谈话”(TBT)的会议中与起重团队讨论该计划，这是他们提问关于自身在操作中角色的重要机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: When heavy loads being moved around, there are some practical things that should be done to prevent accidents.
sentence_translations.translation: 当重型货物被移动时，应当采取一些切实可行的措施来防止事故发生。

sentence_translations.sentence: Firstly, if a load needs to be moved where workers or members of the public are present, the area must have barriers or other means to ensure no one is allowed to walk under the load while it is moving.
sentence_translations.translation: 首先，如果一个负载需要在有工人或公众的场所移动，该区域必须设有围栏或其他措施，以确保在负载移动时没有人被允许从其下方穿行。

sentence_translations.sentence: Secondly, someone called a banksman should always be used when moving heavy loads by crane.
sentence_translations.translation: 其次，在通过起重机移动重物时，必须始终安排一名被称为“指挥员”的人员。

sentence_translations.sentence: As a crane driver often cannot see the load, especially during touch-down, this person tells him or her which way to move it.
sentence_translations.translation: 由于起重机驾驶员通常无法看到负载，尤其是在着地时，该人员会指示驾驶员如何移动负载。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is very unusual for machinery such as cranes to fail.
sentence_translations.translation: 像起重机这样的机械设备发生故障是非常罕见的。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, it is all too easy to ignore the importance of the secondary equipment.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，人们很容易忽视辅助设备的重要性。

sentence_translations.sentence: This refers to those items that are attached between the mechanical lifting machine and the load that is being lifted.
sentence_translations.translation: 这指的是连接在机械起重设备和被提升重物之间的部件。

sentence_translations.sentence: Chains, slings, shackles and rigging are all examples of secondary lifting equipment, and it is perhaps surprising to note that most injuries occur due to faults or weaknesses in these items.
sentence_translations.translation: 链条、吊索、卸扣和索具都是辅助起重设备的例子，而令人惊讶的是，大多数伤害都是由这些部件的缺陷或弱点造成的。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is essential that a six-monthly visual inspection is carried out to ensure there are no signs of wear or damage to the slings and shackles.
sentence_translations.translation: 必须每六个月进行一次目视检查，以确保吊索和卸扣没有磨损或损坏的迹象。

sentence_translations.sentence: Dealing with customer complaints
sentence_translations.translation: 处理客户投诉

sentence_translations.sentence: When a customer complains, it is usually for a good reason.
sentence_translations.translation: 当客户提出投诉时，通常是有充分理由的。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here are some strategies that will help you handle a customer complaint in a smooth and professional manner.
sentence_translations.translation: 以下是一些策略，可帮助您以顺畅且专业的方式处理客户投诉。

sentence_translations.sentence: When a customer presents you with a complaint, keep in mind that the issue is not personal.
sentence_translations.translation: 当顾客向你提出投诉时，请记住问题并非针对个人。

sentence_translations.sentence: Aiming to win the confrontation accomplishes nothing.
sentence_translations.translation: 试图赢得对抗毫无意义。

sentence_translations.sentence: He or she has usually made a purchase that did not meet their expectations - a product, service, or maybe a combination of the two.
sentence_translations.translation: 他或她通常购买了一件未达到期望的商品——可能是产品、服务，或两者的结合。

sentence_translations.sentence: A worker who remains in control of their emotions deals from a position of strength.
sentence_translations.translation: 能够控制自身情绪的员工具备优势地位来处理问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: Let the customer say what they need to.
sentence_translations.translation: 让顾客说出他们想说的话。

sentence_translations.sentence: Respond with phrases such as,‘Hmm’,'I see’, and 'Tell me more'.
sentence_translations.translation: 用诸如‘嗯’、‘我明白了’和‘再多说一些’这样的短语回应。

sentence_translations.sentence: Then be quiet.
sentence_translations.translation: 然后保持安静。

sentence_translations.sentence: As the customer expresses their annoyance yet sees you are not reacting, he or she will begin to relax.
sentence_translations.translation: 当顾客表达他们的不满，却看到你没有反应时，他或她就会开始放松。

sentence_translations.sentence: The customer needs to do this before being able to hear your solution.
sentence_translations.translation: 顾客需要先做到这一点，才能听得进你的解决方案。

sentence_translations.sentence: When the customer has calmed down and feels you have heard his or her side, start asking questions.
sentence_translations.translation: 当顾客冷静下来，并且感到你已听取了他的观点时，开始提问。

sentence_translations.sentence: Be careful not to give scripted replies but use this as an opportunity to start a genuine conversation, building relationship of trust with your customer.
sentence_translations.translation: 注意不要给出照本宣科的回复，而是以此为契机开启一场真诚的对话，与顾客建立信任关系。

sentence_translations.sentence: To help you under stand the situation, get as many details as possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了帮助你理解情况，尽可能获取更多细节。

sentence_translations.sentence: Take charge of the situation and let the customer know what you are going to do to solve the problem.
sentence_translations.translation: 掌控局面，并让客户知道你打算如何解决这个问题。

sentence_translations.sentence: One thing to keep in mind is that you should know what you can and cannot do within the policy of the business you work for.
sentence_translations.translation: 需要牢记的一点是，你应该清楚在所在公司的政策范围内，哪些是你可以做的，哪些是不能做的。

sentence_translations.sentence: The cost could be minimal maybe a simple upgrade on the customer’s next purchase or a small gift certificate.
sentence_translations.translation: 成本可能很低，也许只是客户下次购买时的一次简单升级，或是一张小额的礼品券。

sentence_translations.sentence: A simple gesture like this could result in a word-of-mouth recommendation to others, while making a promise you cannot commit to will only set you back.
sentence_translations.translation: 像这样简单的举动可能会带来他人的口碑推荐，而做出你无法兑现的承诺只会让你倒退。

parts.article_title: White storks back in Britain after hundreds of years

paragraphs.text: These beautiful birds could be about to become a feature of the British landscape again
paragraphs.translation:
这些美丽的鸟类可能即将再次成为英国自然景观的一个特色。
这些美丽的鸟儿可能即将再次成为英国景观的一个特色。

paragraphs.text: A

The last definitive record of a pair of white storks successfully breeding in Britain was in 1416, from a nest on St Giles Cathedral in Edinburgh. No one knows why storks disappeared from our shores. They often featured on the menus of medieval banquets so we might, quite simply, have consumed them all. But there could be a more ominous reason. Storks are migrants ariving after the end of winter, nesting on rooftops and happily associating with humans, and because of this they have long been a symbol of hope and new life. Yet their association with rebirth also meant they became a symbol of rebellion. Shortly after the restoration of King Charles II in 1660, while storks were rare but surviving, parliament debated putting greater effort into destroying them entirely for fear they might inspire republicanism. Today, fortunately, that notion has disappeared and the stork retains its association with new life, appearing on cards given to celebrate the arrival of a new child, as a bird carrying a baby in a sling held in its beak.

paragraphs.text: B

So, after such a long absence, there was great excitement when in April of this year a pair of white storks built an untidy nest of sticks in the top branches of a huge oak in the middle of our rewilding project at Knepp Estate in West Sussex. Drone footage, taken before the pair started sitting on them, showed three large eggs. The fact that they were infertile and did not hatch was not too disappointing. The pair are only four years old, and storks can live to over thirty, with their first attempts to breed often failing. Prospects for next year are encouraging. These young storks are part of a project to return the species to Britain, inspired by reintroductions in European countries that more than reached their target.

paragraphs.text: C

In the face of reports of unrelenting ecological loss (the UN estimates a million species are on the brink of extinction globally), the white stork’s return is refreshing news. As tens of thousands of people demonstrate about the growing climate crisis and eco-anxiety besets us, these glimpses of restoration are important. Featuring the storks in BBC television’s Springwatch in June, the ecologist Chris Packham described the project as ‘ imaginative, intelligent, progressive and practical'.

Support from conservation bodies has been surprisingly difficult to obtain; some were hard pressed with their own initiatives, while others were simply reluctant to stick their necks out. They also had concerns that English-bred birds would migrate across the Channel, and feared that their messy nests and closeness to humans would cause a hazard - rubbish falling down people’s chimneys. What makes it in some ways special is that it has had to rely on private individuals actually building the introduction pens themselves and feeding the birds at their own expense. sentence_translations.sentence: Support from conservation bodies has been surprisingly difficult to obtain; some were hard pressed with their own initiatives, while others were simply reluctant to stick their necks out.
sentence_translations.translation: 从保护机构获得支持出乎意料地困难；有些机构因自身项目而自顾不暇，而另一些则只是不愿冒风险。

sentence_translations.sentence: In addition the committee of the Sussex Wildlife Trust raised doubts about the stork ever having been a British bird.
sentence_translations.translation: 此外，苏塞克斯野生动物信托基金会委员会对白鹳是否曾是英国本土鸟类提出了质疑。

sentence_translations.sentence: They also had concerns that English-bred birds would migrate across the Channel, and feared that their messy nests and closeness to humans would cause a hazard - rubbish falling down people’s chimneys.
sentence_translations.translation: 他们还担心在英国繁殖的鸟类会飞越英吉利海峡迁徙，并且担心它们凌乱的巢穴以及靠近人类会带来危险——垃圾掉进人们的烟囱里。

sentence_translations.sentence: So how has the reintroduction project managed to get going?
sentence_translations.translation: 那么，这个重新引入项目是如何得以启动的呢？

sentence_translations.sentence: What makes it in some ways special is that it has had to rely on private individuals actually building the introduction pens themselves and feeding the birds at their own expense.
sentence_translations.translation: 它在某些方面之所以特别，是因为它不得不依靠个人自行建造引入围栏，并自费喂养这些鸟类。

sentence_translations.sentence: The expertise of tiny yet determined conservation charities such as the Roy Dennis Wildlife Foundation responsible for the successful reintroductions of ospreys and white-tailed eagles to Britain - has been very welcome.
sentence_translations.translation: 像罗伊·丹尼斯野生动物基金会这样规模虽小但意志坚定的保护慈善机构所提供的专业知识非常受欢迎，该基金会曾成功将鱼鹰和白尾海雕重新引入英国。

sentence_translations.sentence: And the support of Cotswold Wildlife Park, which quarantined the original Polish birds and continues to manage and cover the costs of the captive-breeding programme using its own well trained staff and excellent facilities, has proved invaluable.
sentence_translations.translation: 而科茨沃尔德野生动物园的支持也证明是无价的，该园对最初来自波兰的鸟类进行了检疫，并继续利用自己训练有素的员工和出色的设施来管理和承担人工繁殖项目的费用。

sentence_translations.sentence: Across Europe, as stork populations have suffered from the draining of wetlands and disappearance of insect-rich pastures and meadows, their loss has been felt deeply.
sentence_translations.translation: 在整个欧洲，随着鹳的数量因湿地排水以及富含昆虫的牧场和草地的消失而遭受重创，它们的消失已被深切感受到。

sentence_translations.sentence: A few years ago, a tearful old woman in a village in Belarus showed me the nest on her roof, empty of storks for the first time in living memory.
sentence_translations.translation: 几年前，白俄罗斯一个村庄里一位泪眼婆娑的老妇给我看了她屋顶上的巢穴，那是有生以来第一次鹳鸟不在其中。

sentence_translations.sentence: Where storks have been reintroduced, they are greeted with great happiness and some historical stork festivals have been restored.
sentence_translations.translation: 在鹳被重新引入的地方，它们受到极大的欢迎，一些历史上的鹳节也已恢复。

sentence_translations.sentence: The Spanish erect poles for nests along their motorways, and in Alsace householders install cartwheels for storks to build nests on their roofs.
sentence_translations.translation: 西班牙人在高速公路沿线竖立巢穴杆，而在阿尔萨斯，住户们安装马车轮子供鹳在屋顶筑巢。

sentence_translations.sentence: During a cold snap in Bulgaria last March, villagers even gave white storks access to their homes.
sentence_translations.translation: 去年三月保加利亚寒潮期间，村民们甚至让白鹳进入他们的家中。

sentence_translations.sentence: A driving motivation behind the project in the UK is the aspiration that the storks return will spark feelings of empathy and affection from townspeople who see their nests on rooftops.
sentence_translations.translation: 英国该项目背后的一个主要推动力是，希望鹳的回归能激发城镇居民在看到屋顶上的巢穴时产生同情和喜爱之情。

sentence_translations.sentence: They might also encourage the public to feel worried about the wider area where they fly to feed on earthworms, grasshoppers and frogs.
sentence_translations.translation: 它们也可能促使公众对它们飞去觅食蚯蚓、蚱蜢和青蛙的更广阔区域感到担忧。

sentence_translations.sentence: White storks could be that charismatic species that connects urban communities directly with landscape restoration.
sentence_translations.translation: 白鹳可能成为一种魅力物种，将城市社区与景观恢复直接联系起来。

sentence_translations.sentence: Certainly, people once loved them here.
sentence_translations.translation: 当然，这里的人们曾经喜爱它们。

sentence_translations.sentence: The name of our local village, Storrington was originally ‘Estorcheton’ or ‘home of the storks'.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们当地村庄的名字斯托灵顿最初是“埃斯托彻顿”，意为“鹳的家园”。

sentence_translations.sentence: The public response has been overwhelming, with crowds coming to see white storks flying free in England for the first time in hundreds of years, and private landowners queueing up to offer more introduction sites.
sentence_translations.translation: 公众反响热烈，成群的人前来观看数百年来首次在英格兰自由飞翔的白鹳，私人土地所有者纷纷排队提供更多的引进地点。

sentence_translations.sentence: The flight of the white stork over Britain is the triumph of practical action over bureaucracy, self-interest and negativity.
sentence_translations.translation: 白鹳在英国上空飞翔，是实际行动对官僚主义、自私自利和消极态度的胜利。
